title: Automated Nucleic Acid Extraction Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload custom labware definition, if needed.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare protocol files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol bundle, upload it to the OT App, and upload a custom labware definition if required.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the Opentrons Magnetic Module, two Axygen 300 µL plates (sample and elution), a NEST 12‑well reservoir with reagents (magnetic beads, ethanol, elution buffer), and tip racks on the deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the tip racks, both Axygen plates, the magnetic module, and the GEN2 p300 multi‑channel pipette according to the on‑screen instructions.

steps.title: Run automated extraction
steps.instruction: Start the protocol; the robot will perform the following actions for each sample (1–96, processed in multiples of eight):

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL magnetic beads to each well containing 20 µL sample and mix.
Engage the magnetic module and remove the supernatant.
Wash the bound nucleic acid twice with 150 µL ethanol per sample.
Add 50 µL elution buffer to each well and incubate (time as programmed).
Transfer the eluate to the second Axygen plate.

steps.title: Complete run
steps.instruction: When the protocol finishes, remove the plates from the deck and store the eluates as needed.
